banner: ADVISORY / SIMULATED — not financial advice. The edge is IN-SAMPLE; size to SURVIVE the drawdown it will inevitably have, not to maximise the backtest. Full Kelly is flagged too-hot by policy — use 1/4-Kelly. Hany sizes + executes.

method.sizing: risk_per_trade% x equity / ($/R per contract) = contracts
method.risk_of_ruin: seeded Monte-Carlo (20000 sims, seed 4400), fixed-fractional, P(worst drawdown >= band) over a year of trades
